subject: Uploading files to use in a function that takes a filepath/file pattern as argument

messages.author: b419b3f42893b2f1
messages.subject: Uploading files to use in a function that takes a filepath/file pattern as argument
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to make a shiny app that reads and normalizes gene expression data ('.CEL' files) using a function from bioconductor.

I've run into a problem as the function (SCAN {SCAN.UPC}) has an argument 'celFilePattern' that will read all files with a given pattern (e.g. '*.CEL') in a given folder, and will normalize and format the data. This works well 'off-line', but when trying to upload them into my Shiny app, the fileInput() function in shiny does not work, at least not the way I've tried. The function expects a file pattern in a folder to match files with. 

Does anyone have any idea on how to handle this issue? I don't suppose it's possible to do something like 
1. Upload the files
2. The app temporarily stores them in a temporary folder
3. Have the SCAN function to read them from the temporary folder

Would be great to find a solution to this that works both on a local server and on shinyapps,io...

Here is a link to the function in question: http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/SCAN.UPC.html

Thanks!
Anders
